meta.name: Europe from Above
meta.description: Using the very latest in drone and aerial photographic technology, tour across countries and their seasons, getting a unique view from above.

videos.title: The Netherlands
videos.overview: This spectacular aerial journey across the Netherlands, reveals ancient windmills, futuristic greenhouses and the world's biggest bonfire.

videos.title: Italy
videos.overview: A spectacular aerial journey across Italy reveals dredging boats in Venice, the ladder top fishermen of Sicily and a winter school for supercars.

videos.title: Germany
videos.overview: A spectacular aerial journey across Germany, revealing a factory the size of a city, a fairy-tale castle and the largest land vehicle on Earth.

videos.title: United Kingdom
videos.overview: This spectacular aerial journey reveals The United Kingdom, as we've never seen it before. Flying camera's soar over the Giant's Causeway as jet-ski litter pickers tidy up the coast. Daredevil gardeners handle chainsaws while hanging from the Eden Project roof and we glide through the London skyline as one of the city's tallest skyscrapers gets a spring clean.

videos.title: Spain
videos.overview: This spectacular aerial journey reveals Spain, as we've never seen it before. Flying cameras soar over the Sagrada Familia as architects work around the clock to finish the building. Daredevil barnacle hunters rappel down jagged cliffs to hunt for one of the world's most exclusive shellfish and we glide over one of the world's greatest abandoned buildings nestled deep in Spain's northern mountains.

videos.title: Poland
videos.overview: This spectacular aerial journey reveals Poland as we've never seen it before. Flying cameras swoop over the largest castle in the world, zoom through fireworks over Krakow, and witness the struggles of European Bison, the largest land animal in Europe. This bird's eye view of Poland also reveals a nation undergoing an astonishing transformation - in Warsaw Poles are hard at work building what will become the tallest building in the EU.

videos.title: France
videos.overview: A spectacular aerial journey across France reveals a cultural powerhouse set in a vast landscape of contrasts and surprises.

videos.title: Greece
videos.overview: Aerial photography reveals the secrets of Greece, set in a vast landscape where myth and legend collide with the modern world.

videos.title: Hungary
videos.overview: Aerial photography reveals the wonders of Hungary; the Hungarian planes, a record-breaking bridge project and Europe's largest ice rink.

videos.title: Sweden
videos.overview: An aerial journey across Sweden reveals the restoration of Stockholm Palace.

videos.title: Finland
videos.overview: A spectacular aerial journey across Finland, reveals mega ice breaking ships, Europe's last indigenous people and the weirdest sauna in the world.

videos.title: Turkey
videos.overview: This spectacular aerial journey across Turkey, reveals hot air balloons over Cappadocia, a record breaking bridge and Europe's last nomads.

videos.title: Ireland
videos.overview: This unique aerial voyage across Ireland reveals the dramatic Dublin Deer Rut, a record-breaking logistical challenge and the home of Gaelic Sport.

videos.title: Norway
videos.overview: This unique aerial voyage across Norway reveals the world's longest deep-sea cable, a 13th-century church restoration, and a breath-taking postal route.

videos.title: Croatia
videos.overview: An aerial tour of Croatia reveals a Roman architectural masterpiece, a climbing paradise, and a natural floodplain the size of New York City.

videos.title: Portugal
videos.overview: A striking aerial journey across Portugal, discovering Lisbon's mosaic pavements, a kaleidoscopic castle and a record-breaking footbridge.

videos.title: Iceland
videos.overview: Take an aerial voyage across Iceland and encounter volcanic eruptions, rare footage of humpback whales feeding and stunning architecture.

videos.title: Switzerland
videos.overview: A spectacular aerial journey across Switzerland reveals Europe's highest observatory, an earthquake-proof skyscraper and a gravity-defying railway.

videos.title: Scotland
videos.overview: An aerial view of Scotland reveals an astonishing tidal energy project, a majestic cliff-top castle and the world’s first golf course.

videos.title: Denmark
videos.overview: Take an aerial journey over Denmark and discover a power plant with a ski slope for a roof, traditional homes made from eelgrass and more.

videos.title: Serbia
videos.overview: As you take to the skies over Serbia, learn about a record-breaking skyscraper, a unique way of harvesting peppers and an animal conservation effort.

videos.title: Belgium
videos.overview: Taking to the skies over Belgium, with a visit to the country's largest church, a building shaped like an iron crystal and a spectacular light event.

videos.title: Bulgaria
videos.overview: A spectacular aerial journey across Bulgaria reveals Varna's magnificent cathedral restoration, a UFO-like monument and the ruins of an ancient sanctuary.

videos.title: Romania
videos.overview: Take an aerial journey across Romania and discover the world’s biggest Orthodox Cathedral, a narrow-gauge steam train and ‘Castle Dracula’.

videos.title: British Islands
videos.overview: This aerial tour of the islands of Great Britain reveals a picturesque beach airport, an oil rig recycling operation and a dramatic Viking fire festival.

videos.title: Mediterranean
videos.overview: An aerial tour of the Mediterranean that reveals iconic beach umbrellas, Croatia’s loneliest lighthouse, and Christmas celebrations in Malta.

videos.title: Benelux
videos.overview: An outstanding aerial journey across the Benelux region reveals the world’s biggest storm barrier, one of Europe’s busiest ports, and a mesmerising giant flower carpet.

videos.title: Spanish Islands
videos.overview: A birds-eye view of the Canaries and Balearic Islands of Spain that showcases astonishing marine mammals, and unique vineyards. A gothic Cathedral welcomes a rare light phenomenon.

videos.title: Nordics
videos.overview: An aerial journey over the Nordic region reveals the world’s longest continuous staircase, a special Atlantic Puffin conservation effort and a festive kayak parade.

videos.title: Alps
videos.overview: An aerial view over the Alps region reveals a solar panel engineering feat, a hot air balloon festival and a flight alongside the Northern Bald Ibis.

videos.title: Iberia
videos.overview: Iberia is a region that consists of Spain, Portugal, Andorra and Gibraltar. Many records exist including longest roller coaster, window cleaning operations, biggest Christmas tree, and biggest floating solar power electricity generator.

videos.title: Greek Islands
videos.overview: The Greek Islands are an extensive chain of Islands, and attractions include sailing, Santorini's mountainous skyline, a quarry of volcanic glass, and an explosive fireworks festival amongst others.

videos.title: Great Britain
videos.overview: Castles, canals, tidal rivers, one of a kind woolly cattle, giant wetlands, high speed rail lines, festivals and alternate artists are just a few of the things that makes Great Britain one of the most amazing Islands on earth

videos.title: Balkans
videos.overview: The Balkans, predominantly mountainous, consists of 12 countries, and is surrounded on the coastline by the Adriatic Sea, the Ionian Sea, the Aegean Sea and the Black Sea. It is a world of architecture, landscapes and traditions.

videos.title: Polish Riviera
videos.overview: Poland, bordered by Germany and Kaliningrad counts amongst its attractions, a giant container port, an abandoned mega factory and a vibrant Christmas Market.

videos.title: Lapland
videos.overview: The area known collectively as Lapland has many amazing attractions, including the world's fastest tidal current, a glittering snow village that is built each year, massive ice breaking ships, and an entire village moved by road.

videos.title: Christmas from Above
videos.overview: From a dazzling train of lights along England's coast and an Alpine fireworks show to Finland's reindeer herds, we soar over Europe to reveal how vibrant Christmas celebrations light up the continent.
